proposals.title: Swedish Women’s National Team Roster Announcement for Summer 2026
proposals.description: The Swedish Basketball Federation announced the 24‑player preliminary roster for the senior women’s national team, which will be used for the EuroBasket Women 2026 camps and the tournament in Valencia, Spain (17‑27 June 2026). The list includes Klara Lundquist and Ellen Nyström, members of the Svensk dambasket breddgrupp.
proposals.context: Preparation for EuroBasket Women 2026 (Valencia, Spain) and summer training camps.

evidence.title: Damlandslagets bruttotrupp inför Basket‑EM uttagen
evidence.summary: The federation released the 24‑player preliminary squad for the women’s national team ahead of the EuroBasket. The article lists Klara Lundquist and Ellen Nyström among the selected players and notes that preparations start 19 May with a training camp, leading to the EuroBasket (17‑27 June).
evidence.rawExcerpt: Förbundskapten Marco Crespi har tagit ut de 24 spelare som ingår i damlandslagets bruttotrupp … Klara Lundquist … Ellen Nyström … Förberedelserna startar 19 maj. Basket‑EM spelas 17‑27 juni i Valencia, Spanien.
